appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Declining Telehealth Follow-up Requests from 2012 to 2023'.
Chart subtitle: 'Program demand record shown in the dashboard summary'.
Single dark teal line series representing telehealth follow-up requests over time.
The line shows a general upward trend from 2012 to 2022, peaking around 2022, followed by a decline in 2023.

public_definitions: Review the telehealth follow-up demand dashboard and select the operational route that best fits the overall request pattern for this record.
Use the dashboard as the evidence source for selecting the appropriate telehealth follow-up demand route.
The three options are: 'Route the record to growth-response follow-up', 'Route the record to decline-response follow-up', 'Route the record to standard monitoring follow-up'.
